newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Falmouth, Mass.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Falmouth, Mass.

text.p: The Town of Falmouth, Massachusetts, will receive
proposals until 11:00 A.M., Eastern Daylight Savings Time, on Tuesday,

for the purchase of the following described Bonds of the Town.The Bonds will be dated September 1, 1997 and interest will accrue from that date. Principal of the Bonds will be payable semiannually on September 1 and March 1, commencing March 1, 1998. The Bonds mature as follows:
The original Bonds to be immobilized at DTC and their legality approved by Ropes &Gray, Boston, Massachusetts, whose opinion will be furnished to the purchaser without charge.
The Bonds maturing in the years 1999 through 2007, inclusive, shall not be subject to redemption prior to their stated maturities.

Bonds maturing on and after March 1, 2008, shall be subject to redemption prior to maturity, at the option of the Town, on and after March 1, 2007, as described more fully; the preliminary Official Statement.

For Bonds maturing on and after March 1, 2008 bidders may specify that all of the principal amount of such Bonds in any two or more consecutive years may, be combined to comprise one or more Term Bonds. Bidders may specify no more than two Term Bonds.

All bids should be sealed and marked Proposal for Bonds'' and addressed to Ms. Carol Martin, Town Treasurer, Town of Falmouth, c/o the Fleet Securities, Inc., Municipal Advisory Group, Second Floor, 75 State Street, (MABOF02M) Boston, Massachusetts 02109.
The right is reserved to reject any or all bids and to reject any bid not complying with this Notice of Sale and, so far as permitted by law, to waive any irregularity with respect to any proposal.
Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement may be obtained from the Municipal Advisory Group, Fleet
